title: 第7章 天王老子来了这也是好妹妹第8章 光速购表
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：财富自由从毕业开始第7章天王老子来了这也是好妹妹（..）第二家店，周望选择的是老牌奢侈品“路易威登”
说实话周望不是太喜欢LV的风格，毕竟是做箱包起家的，他家可供选择的男士成装不是太多，如果不是考虑到LV比较贵，万一青龙刀能砍出惊喜，周望说不定会出门左拐选择衣服更多的阿玛尼。
最后周望在冉冉的建议下，想着以后确实可能用得上，就买了一整套Newformal系列的黑色正装。
为此周望又额外买了一个他家S-LOCK的公文包来和衣服配套，也是为了拉高系统评分，按周望自己的风格，他平常是不会用包的。
结账的时候，衣服11万多，包接近3万，加起来15万不到。
刷了卡之后，系统的提示声如期而至，印象评分“81”
……好吧，果然连系统都不喜欢LV的衣服，看来老子还是有品位的。
周望暗暗吐槽，还好他多搭配了个包，不然可能连80分都没有。
返还比例只有81%，不算青龙刀的返还的话，等于这波血亏3万。
让周望失望的是，青龙刀也没有再出暴击，只给了0.5倍的返还，也就是7万多。
还好，一来一回最后算是赚了4万多，要是出个0.1倍他还是得亏。
“哥哥，我最近心情不太好，你能不能帮我一個小忙呀？”
周望正要叫着冉冉去下一家店，结果冉冉却停下了脚步。
仿佛是为了强调只是一件很小的事情，冉冉还特意两根手指捏在一起比划了一下，模样十分的萌。
“你说。”
“是这样的，我想换一张手机屏保，因为人家都说心情不好就要经常看帅哥，可是我又找不到合适的图片，所以……我能帮你拍几张照片么？”
冉冉背着手，身体微微前倾，用明亮的眼神注视着周望，说到最后嘴角翘起，露出了一丝俏皮的笑容。
周望一开始听的云里雾里，等到冉冉“图穷匕见”
的时候他才反应过来。
卧槽……

周望眼皮跳了一下，一时间心中就只剩下了这两个字。
听听，都给我坐下来好好听，什么叫会说话？
明明是帮自己拍照片，结果冉冉却是一副恳求的语气，还明说了是要拿照片去做自己的屏保，顺带夸赞了周望一波……
这搁谁不迷糊啊！
周望决定收回自己之前的评价。
这样的女孩怎么能用“有心机”
来形容，天王老子来这也是善解人意的好妹妹啊！
周望当然找不到拒绝的理由，应该也没有哪个正常的男人拒绝得了一个有颜有料的女孩子这样的请求。
“嘿嘿！”
见周望同意了，冉冉就把他拉到了商场里一面装饰用的背景墙前，掏出手机，“咔嚓”
“咔嚓”
就是一顿拍。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Wealth Freedom Begins from Graduation Chapter 7 The King of Heaven Is Here This is also the second store of Good Sister (..). Zhou Wang chose the old luxury brand "Louis Vuitton"
To be honest, Zhou Wang doesn't like LV's style too much. After all, he started out as a luggage maker, and he doesn't have too many men's ready-made clothes to choose from. If it weren't for the fact that LV is relatively expensive, and if the Qinglong Sword can surprise him, Zhou Wang might go out and choose Armani, which has more clothes.
Finally, under Ran Ran's suggestion, Zhou Wang bought a complete set of black formal wear from the Newformal series, thinking that it might be useful in the future.
For this reason, Zhou Wang bought an additional S-LOCK briefcase to match his clothes, also to improve the system score. According to Zhou Wang's own style, he usually does not use bags.
When I checked out, the clothes cost more than 110,000, and the bags were close to 30,000. The total was less than 150,000.
After swiping the card, the system prompts as expected, and the impression score is "81"
...Well, as expected, even the system doesn't like LV's clothes. It seems that I still have good taste.
Zhou Wang secretly complained, luckily he had an extra bag, otherwise he might not have even scored 80 points.
The return ratio is only 81%. Not counting the return of the Qinglong Sword, this is equivalent to a blood loss of 30,000.
To Zhou Wang's disappointment, the Qinglong Sword did not hit again, and only gave 0.5 times the refund, which was more than 70,000.
Fortunately, after going back and forth, he finally made more than 40,000 yuan. If he paid 0.1 times, he would still lose money.
"Brother, I'm not in a good mood lately, can you do me a little favor?"
Zhou Wang was about to call Ran Ran to go to the next store, but Ran Ran stopped.
As if to emphasize that it was just a small thing, Ran Ran even pinched her two fingers together to make a gesture, which looked very cute.
"You said."
"It's like this, I want to change my phone screen saver, because people say that when you're in a bad mood, you should always look at handsome guys, but I can't find a suitable picture, so... can I take some pictures for you?"
Ran Ran put her hands behind her back, leaned forward slightly, looked at Zhou Wang with bright eyes, and at the end of her speech, the corners of her mouth turned up, revealing a playful smile.
Zhou Wang was confused when he heard it at first, but when he slowly said,
Only then did he react.
Damn it...
Zhou Wang's eyelids twitched, and for a moment these two words were the only ones left in his mind.
Listen, sit down and listen carefully. What does it mean to be able to talk?
It was obvious that he was taking a photo for himself, but in the end, Ran Ran had a pleading tone, and even said that he wanted to use the photo as his screensaver, and by the way, he praised Zhou Wangbo...
Who wouldn’t be confused here?
Zhou Wang decided to retract his previous evaluation.
How can such a girl use the word "scheming"?
To describe it, I am also a considerate and good sister here!
Of course Zhou Wang couldn't find a reason to refuse, and no normal man could refuse such a request from a pretty girl.
"Hey!"
Seeing that Zhou Wang agreed, Ran Ran pulled him to a decorative background wall in the mall, took out his mobile phone, and clicked
"Click"
Just one shot.
